newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bank injected up to 20 bln baht on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Thai bank injected up to 20 bln baht on Friday.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand (BOT) injected about 17 to 20 billion baht into the system through its bond repurchase market on Friday to ease tightening liquidity, a senior BOT official said on Monday.
Siri Ganjarerndee, BOT assistant governor, attributed the recently tight money supply to heavy speculative buying of the dollar, the central bank's coming reserve requirement and some tax payments.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 13.00-13.50 early from 12.75-13.00 late on Friday amid tight market liquidity.
